About the Artist

The Art of Henna

Rooted in centuries of tradition, henna is more than decoration — it is celebration, blessing, and beauty woven into skin. I am Sheetal, and each design I create is drawn freehand with love, precision, and a deep respect for this timeless art form.

From intricate bridal full-arm designs to elegant minimalist patterns for everyday occasions, I offer a range of styles tailored to every client and every moment. Let me adorn your story.
